'''San Marco''' is one of the six [[sestiere (Venice)|sestieri]] of [[Venice]], lying in the heart of the city as the main place of Venice.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Kaplan |first1=Paul |last2=Bassi |first2=Shaul |chapter=The Sestiere of San Marco |title=African Venice: A Guide to Art, Culture and People |date=2025 |pages=83–98 |doi=10.1515/9780271100012-008 |isbn=978-0-271-10001-2}}</ref> San Marco also includes the island of [[San Giorgio Maggiore]].<ref name=DK /> Although the district includes [[Piazza San Marco|Saint Mark's Square]], that was never administered as part of the sestiere.

==Overview==
The small district includes many of Venice's most famous sights, including [[Piazza San Marco|St Mark's Square]], [[Saint Mark's Basilica]], the [[Doge's Palace, Venice|Doge's Palace]], [[Harry's Bar (Venice)|Harry's Bar]], the [[Palazzo Dandolo]], [[Palazzo Corner Contarini dei Cavalli]], [[Palazzo Venier Contarini]], [[Palazzo Corner Valmarana]], [[Palazzo D'Anna Viaro Martinengo Volpi di Misurata]], [[Palazzo Cavalli]], [[San Moisè]], the [[La Fenice]] theatre, the [[Palazzo Grassi]] and [[Palazzo Bellavite]], and the [[Church (building)|church]]es of [[San Beneto]], [[San Fantin]], [[Santa Maria Zobenigo|Santa Maria del Giglio]], [[San Maurizio (Venice)|San Maurizio]], [[San Moisè]], [[Santo Stefano di Venezia|Santo Stefano]], [[San Salvador di Venezia|San Salvador]], [[San Zulian]] and [[San Samuele, Venice|San Samuele]].<ref name=DK>{{cite book |title=DK Eyewitness Travel Guide Venice and the Veneto |date=2016 |publisher=[[Dorling Kindersley]] |isbn=978-0-241-25814-9 |pages=76–99 |url=https://www.google.es/books/edition/DK_Eyewitness_Travel_Guide_Venice_and_th/g8jeCgAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22Sestiere+of+San+Marco%22&pg=PA77}}</ref>

The area is densely built and was the location of Venice's government. It is now heavily [[tourist]]ed and there are many [[hotel]]s, [[bank]]s and expensive [[Retailing#Shops and stores|shops]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Buckley |first1=Jonathan |title=The Rough Guide to Venice & the Veneto |date=2004 |publisher=[[Rough Guides]] |isbn=978-1-84353-302-3 |pages=36–85 |url=https://www.google.es/books/edition/The_Rough_Guide_to_Venice_the_Veneto/Y0qn0foDpUMC?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=%22Sestiere+of+San+Marco%22&pg=PA36}}</ref>

San Marco is also a place which is used in several video games such as in ''[[Tekken]]'', ''[[Assassin's Creed II]]'', and ''[[Venetica]]''.
